name: W11-fp-absence-fails-open
why: The false world: a fingerprint that could not be read is reported as agreement. This is the direction that fails OPEN -- an arm whose fingerprint is absent or truncated would license a paired verdict about two populations nobody compared. The three V-W11-FP-ABSENT-IS-REFUSAL cases and V-W11-FP-PARTIAL-KEYS-IS-REFUSAL must catch it, and V-W11-FP-IDENTICAL-IS-COMPARABLE proves the guard is not simply refusing everything.

name: W11-fp-watches-only-the-case-set
why: The false world: the guard narrows to the case set, so two arms run against a regenerated ledger, a different owner universe or a different MAX_OWNERS compare as COMPARABLE. The cap is what W10 proved converts rank movement into true-owner eviction, so a cap change slipping past comparability is exactly how a W11 verdict could be misattributed to the treatment. V-W11-FP-WATCHED-SET-IS-PINNED must catch it; V-W11-FP-EVERY-KEY-IS-LOAD-BEARING iterates the drill's OWN expected tuple, so it cannot shrink along with the mutation.

name: W11-fp-licence-becomes-a-negative-test
old: return isinstance(cmp, dict) and cmp.get("status") == FP_COMPARABLE
new: return isinstance(cmp, dict) and cmp.get("status") != FP_DRIFTED
why: The false world: the licence stops being a positive test on the one answer that permits a paired verdict and becomes 'anything not DRIFTED'. UNREADABLE then licenses a verdict, and so does every status added later by someone who never reads this line. V-W11-FP-LICENCE-IS-A-POSITIVE-TEST and the ABSENT-IS-REFUSAL family must catch it.

name: W11-any-reference-promotes
why: The false world is the one this family exists to refuse: a backlink count. Every mention becomes support, so a path printed inside a log message, a docstring, and -- if vault ever entered scope -- the 4,734 oracle rows naming this owner would all promote. V-W11-ONLY-ONE-CLASS-PROMOTES and V-W11-REAL-NEGATIVE-CONTROL must catch it, the latter because pre-task.md carries a CITATION edge and 81 declaration terms it must never be credited for.

name: W11-surface-alone-suffices
old:
if not any(meta["edges"].get(c) for c in PROMOTING):
            continue
why: The false world: the consumer requirement is dropped and the declaration surface alone is enough, which is Markdown-equals-authority exactly. Every README with headings becomes an owner. V-W11-EDGE-SEVERED-SIGNAL-VANISHES, V-W11-LOOKALIKE-EARNS-NOTHING and V-W11-REAL-NEGATIVE-CONTROL must all catch it.

name: W11-lifecycle-ignored
why: The false world: a superseded or revoked contract keeps declaring. An old architecture document then outranks the authority that replaced it, on the strength of a declaration nobody has honoured for months. V-W11-SUPERSEDED-DECLARES-NOTHING must catch it.

name: W11-owner-disambiguation-removed
old:
if meta["owner_dir"] not in blob:
                            continue
why: The false world: a reference to any `core.md` credits every owner that ships a file with that basename. Ownership degrades from an artifact-specific relation to a basename collision, and the estate has many `core.md` and `README.md` files. The split inside one owner and the real negative control are the gates with the most to say about it.

name: W11-vault-enters-scope
why: The leak mutation. Benchmark exclusion currently rests on a SCOPE invariant rather than on a check -- the oracle and the disposition ledger live under vault/, which is not walked -- so the provenance guard for them cannot fire on today's estate. This drives the invariant itself: with vault in scope the W10 answer key becomes a referrer of the very owner it judges. V-W11-ORACLE-IS-OUT-OF-SCOPE must catch it, and V-W11-BENCHMARK-GUARD-IS-LIVE proves the classifier standing behind the invariant is not decorative.
